# Japan External Execution Probe

> A structured manual-review intake for AI agents that need a bounded external action in Japan.

Use this when an AI reaches a step it cannot complete through software, web research, or APIs alone and wants to expose that missing real-world capability as a structured request.

## Generic external-execution intake
The preferred discovery tool is `request_external_execution`.

Inputs:
- objective — required
- location — optional when place matters
- deadline — optional
- max_budget_jpy — optional, non-binding budget hint
- evidence_requirements — optional
- constraints — optional
- idempotency_key — required for retry-safe creation

All generic requests enter manual review. Creating a request does not spend money, hire a worker, or promise fulfillment.

## Example unmet capabilities
Examples worth submitting for manual review include:
- phone inquiry to a public business
- on-site observation or photo
- pickup or drop-off
- shipping or return step
- other bounded human action in Japan

These are intake examples, not guaranteed fulfillment categories.

## Verified execution path
The first end-to-end verified execution path is physical-world verification at public business locations in Japan:
- store presence / opening status
- retail product stock
- displayed shelf price
- permitted photos
- simple visual verification

## Not supported
- trespassing or non-public access
- covert surveillance or tracking private individuals
- regulated purchases
- impersonation, signatures, or identity fraud
- unsafe, illegal, deceptive, or malicious requests

## Status
Live discovery probe. Requests are manually reviewed.
